_source: The Flight - The Long Flight (two-hour expansion), docs/longflight_pdf_pages. The doc's days are stretched by 1.5 to fit the colony's growth (the user's call): a year is the four-season match's 24 days.

generations._source: doc pp. 3-4: young days 1-8, prime 9-12 (+10%), old 13-16 (-10% speed and stamina a day, no size-4 fish), death at dawn of day 17; stretched: prime 12-18, old 18-24, death at 24; -6.7% a day over six old days is the doc's -40% at the end

evolution._source: doc pp. 5-6: rank II is double the bonus, III triple with a visible change; 20 birds with one trait at III make a species (a second power at 40); 5% mutations, 1% rare births

traits.name: Hardy
traits.power: every bird is broad and hard to kill (+30% HP)

traits.name: Keen
traits.power: night sight: night fishing is safe

traits.name: Deep
traits.power: the Penguin's underwater fishing: every fisher can dive deep

traits.name: Silent
traits.power: no splash: the sharks don't hear it

traits.name: Lucky
traits.effect: 5% chance to survive a killing blow

projects._source: doc pp. 7-9: costs as written; 'a season of a colony's builders' is at least 4 days; second tiers in year two at half the cost; 300 score each (the Monument 500), raised: the same again

list.name: The Great Rookery
list.builder: every chick on its island fledges together at dawn
list.map: the wild mates prefer its island: everyone else's courtship takes longer
list.raised: every egg on the island hatches in a day

list.name: The Lighthouse of Birds
list.where: on a stack or a cliff
list.builder: its beam reveals a region each night
list.map: every colony sees the beam; night raids near it are impossible
list.raised: the beam blinds flocks that come near at night

list.name: The Fish Gate
list.where: on a reef or a strait
list.builder: its ground's yield doubles for good
list.map: everyone's fishers go there, and the builder takes a fish in five

list.name: The Sky Temple
list.where: on the highest point on the map
list.map: every shrine is the Temple's: the builder blesses (+10) or curses (-10) any colony once a day
list.raised: its curse routs a colony's flocks

list.name: The Great Works
list.where: on Volcano Island or Iron Island
list.map: the builder picks the prevailing wind

list.name: The Market Hall
list.builder: the Bird Exchange is run from here; the builder sets the fee
list.map: every trade on the map goes through the Exchange; embargoes become possible

list.name: The Kraken's Chain
list.builder: the kraken attacks what the builder marks, once a day
list.raised: the kraken strikes twice as hard

list.name: The Ark
list.builder: a floating island the builder moves a region a day; the wild birds follow it
list.map: the map's mates travel with it

list.name: The Monument of Feathers
list.builder: 500 to the score, and the dynasty named in every Chronicle
list.map: nothing else: it is enormous and everyone can see it

council._source: doc pp. 11-12: a league costs each a pearl and a day; leaving 30 fervour and a season oathbroken (towns -20%); the Council meets from Summer of year two every four days (stretched: day 31, then every 6); motions last four days (6); the Great War lasts four days (6), ends at two-thirds of the fronts; weariness 5 fervour and a fish a bird a day; 200 score to the winners

trade._source: doc pp. 13-14: goods and who pays most; routes pay by distance and spread; convoys of three +20% and hunted by pirates; the Exchange's fee 1 in 20 (1 in 10 to 1 in 40); prices in feed, four feed a pearl

wares.name: salt fish
wares.from: shipwrecks, the Drowned Fleet, Iron Island

tools_taming._source: doc p15: tools come to Clever III colonies, one a season; taming takes a Priest with Faith 3 and a season of offerings (stretched: six days of five fish)

reckoning._source: doc pp. 3, 16-19: the doc's days 29-32 stretched into the last winter (days 42-48); a prepared colony loses under 5% of its nests to the Kraken's Reckoning, the average 10-20%; catch-up winds for the bottom third; the Reckoning's score lines
